authority_basis.summary: After deriving Frobenius composition, construct Euler factors from determinants or traces and audit their arithmetic typing.

operations.title: Inertia ghost traces produce exact dynamical Euler factors
operations.statement: For a finite inertia object (X,sigma), w_r=|Fix(sigma^r)|=Tr(sigma^r|Q[X]) and Z(u)=exp(sum_r w_r u^r/r)=det(1-u sigma)^(-1)=product_j(1-u^ell_j)^(-1). Under F_n, each ell-cycle splits into gcd(ell,n) cycles of length ell/gcd(ell,n), compatibly with F_mF_n=F_mn. These are dynamical, not yet arithmetic, Euler factors.
operations.scope: Conditional finite-component inertia dynamics; no prime-to-cycle attachment, finite-field Frobenius, global Euler product, or physical authorization.

operations.title: Prime-cycle determinant hostile test
operations.procedure: For sigma a p-cycle, compute w_r and the determinant before and after F_p. The original factor is (1-u^p)^(-1); F_p sigma is identity on p points and has factor (1-u)^(-p).
operations.expected_result: The trace exponential and determinant agree, and power splitting gives the stated factors. Any mismatch falsifies the theorem.
